views.markdown:
## Where Winds Meet Cheats — iOS Mod Menu

**Target Bundle ID:** `com.netease.yysls`  
**Architecture:** `arm64` (Rootless) & `arm64e` (RootHide)

---

### ⚔️ Combat Features (Protected `__hxc` Lua Engine)
- **God Mode** — No HP loss & `0` enemy damage received
- **Damage Multiplier (`1x – 50x`)** — Multiply outgoing combat damage in Single mode
- **Move Speed (`1.0x – 5.0x`)** — Smooth character movement speed multiplier in Single mode
- **Branch-Stub & Auto-Offset Resolver** — Automatically follows ARM64 branch stubs + AOB signature fallback (`lua_load` / `lua_pcallk`) with stream-cipher payload protection

---

### 🛡️ Protection & Cloud Auto-Update
- **Cloud + On-Device Auto-Offset Engine** — Automatically resolves updated offsets across game updates without waiting for a new `.deb`
- **1-User License System** — Hardware UDID / Keychain device token binding via Hunter's license server
- **Glass UI Floating Mod Menu** — Draggable floating button, multi-tab layout, live sliders & persistent settings

**v1.0.29**
- Updated to Protected Encrypted `__hxc` Lua Engine with ARM64 branch-stub resolution & Anti-Debug
- Synced 1-User Device Token Lock & Cloud Auto-Offset Engine
